zh: 移除令牌的拥有者令牌
移除属于某用户的注册或设备令牌。需在 token_type 中指定 gcm、huawei 或 apns，分别对应 FCM 注册令牌、HMS 设备令牌或 APNs 设备令牌，以匹配所使用的推送服务。
en: Remove a registration or device token from an owner

Removes a registration or device token that belongs to a user. Specify gcm, huawei, or apns in token_type for an FCM registration token, HMS device token, or APNs device token, respectively, to match the push notification service in use.

zh: 查询令牌的拥有者
通过令牌本身查询拥有该注册或设备令牌的用户。需在 token_type 中指定 gcm、huawei 或 apns，分别对应 FCM 注册令牌、HMS 设备令牌或 APNs 设备令牌。
en: View who owns a registration or device token
Retrieves the user who owns a registration or device token. Specify gcm, huawei, or apns in token_type for an FCM registration token, HMS device token, or APNs device token, respectively.

zh: 创建用户
在 Sendbird 应用中创建用户以发起对话。用户以唯一的 user_id 标识，并可设置可更改的昵称、头像等属性；创建后可对用户及其行为进行细粒度控制。
en: Create a user

Creates a user in your Sendbird application to initiate conversations. A user is identified by a unique user_id and can have a changeable nickname, profile image, and more, giving you fine-grained control over users and what they can do.

zh: 查询用户列表
分页获取应用内的用户列表。可通过多种查询参数组合定制筛选范围，生成符合需求的用户列表。
en: List users
Retrieves a paginated list of users in your Sendbird application. Combine various query parameters to customize the filter scope and shape the returned user list.

zh: 删除用户
从应用中删除指定 user_id 的用户。该接口会删除用户数据及其元数据，但不会删除其发送的消息；如需连同消息一并删除，应改用 GDPR 请求。
en: Delete a user
Deletes a user with the given user_id from your application. This deletes the user's data and metadata but not their messages; to delete user data including messages, use a GDPR request instead.

zh: 更新用户信息
更新指定 user_id 用户的信息，可修改昵称、头像，颁发新的访问令牌（将替换旧令牌作为认证所需），也可停用或重新激活用户。若 leave_all_when_deactivated 为 true，停用时用户会退出所有已加入的群组频道。
en: Update a user

Updates information for a user with the given user_id, including changing the nickname or profile image and issuing a new access token that replaces the previous one for authentication. You can also deactivate or reactivate the user; with leave_all_when_deactivated set to true, the user leaves all joined group channels when deactivated.

zh: 查询用户信息
通过 user_id 获取指定用户的详细信息，返回该用户的资源表示，包括昵称、头像等属性。
en: View a user
Retrieves information about a user by user_id, returning the user's resource representation including attributes such as nickname and profile image.

zh: 获取频道邀请偏好
获取指定 user_id 用户在群组频道中的邀请偏好。用户同时受个人偏好与应用级默认偏好的影响，其中针对具体用户设置的邀请偏好优先级更高。
en: Get channel invitation preference

Retrieves a user's group channel invitation preference for the given user_id. Users are subject to both user-specific and application-wide preferences, and the user-specific setting takes precedence over the default.

zh: 更新频道邀请偏好
更新指定 user_id 用户在群组频道中的邀请偏好。更新应用级默认频道邀请偏好不会覆盖已有用户各自的偏好，修改只影响更新后创建的用户。
en: Update channel invitation preference

Updates a user's group channel invitation preference for the given user_id. Updating the application's default preference does not override existing users' individual preferences; the change only affects users created after the update.

zh: 更新频道计数偏好
更新指定 user_id 用户在特定群组频道（channel_url）中的计数偏好，可设置统计未读消息数、未读提及消息数或两者。
en: Update count preference of a channel
Updates a user's count preference for a specific group channel identified by channel_url, choosing whether to track the number of unread messages, unread mentioned messages, or both.

zh: 查看频道计数偏好
获取指定 user_id 用户在特定群组频道（channel_url）中的计数偏好，即该频道统计未读消息数、未读提及消息数或两者的情况。
en: View count preference of a channel
Retrieves a user's count preference for a specific group channel identified by channel_url, i.e., whether the number of unread messages, unread mentioned messages, or both is counted.

zh: 将所有消息标记为已读
将指定 user_id 用户在部分或全部群组频道中的未读消息标记为已读；若未指定频道，则标记其在所有群组频道中的未读消息为已读。
en: Mark all messages as read
Marks a user's unread messages as read in certain group channels; if no channels are specified, the user's unread messages in all group channels are marked as read.

zh: 查询已加入的群组频道
分页获取指定 user_id 用户已加入的群组频道列表。可通过多种查询参数确定搜索范围，并选择返回关于频道的何种信息。
en: List my group channels
Retrieves a paginated list of group channels that a user with the given user_id has joined. Use various query parameters to determine the search scope and select the channel information to return.

zh: 退出我的群组频道
让指定 user_id 用户一次性退出全部群组频道，或仅退出特定 custom_type 的频道。此接口不能对已停用用户调用；只退出单个频道请改用退出频道接口。
en: Leave my group channels

Lets a user leave all of their group channels at once, or only those with a specific custom_type. This API cannot be called for a deactivated user; to leave a single channel, use the leave-a-channel API instead.

zh: 移除全部设备令牌
移除指定 user_id 用户注册的全部注册或设备令牌。可传入 token_type 指定 gcm、huawei 或 apns，分别对应 FCM 注册令牌、HMS 设备令牌或 APNs 设备令牌。
en: Remove all registration or device tokens

Removes all registration or device tokens registered to a user with the given user_id. Specify gcm, huawei, or apns in token_type for FCM registration tokens, HMS device tokens, or APNs device tokens, respectively.

zh: 重置推送偏好
将指定 user_id 用户的通知偏好重置为默认值：do_not_disturb 与 snooze_enabled 设为 false、时间段相关参数归零、时区设为 UTC、push_sound 设为 default。推送通知仅适用于群组频道。
en: Reset push preferences

Resets a user's notification preferences for the given user_id to their defaults: do_not_disturb and snooze_enabled are set to false, time-frame parameters are set to 0, timezone is set to UTC, and push_sound is set to default. Push notifications are only available for group channels.

zh: 更新推送偏好
更新指定 user_id 用户的通知偏好，例如免打扰时段与推送提示音等，以控制设备空闲或应用在后台运行时推送消息的送达方式。推送通知仅适用于群组频道。
en: Update push preferences

Updates a user's notification preferences for the given user_id, such as do-not-disturb periods and push sound, controlling how push messages are delivered when the device is idle or the app runs in the background. Push notifications are only available for group channels.

zh: 查看推送偏好
获取指定 user_id 用户当前的通知偏好设置，包括免打扰、暂免通知、时区及推送提示音等。推送通知仅适用于群组频道。
en: View push preferences

Retrieves a user's current notification preferences for the given user_id, including do-not-disturb, snooze, timezone, and push sound settings. Push notifications are only available for group channels.

zh: 更新频道推送偏好
更新指定 user_id 用户在特定群组频道（channel_url）中的通知偏好，例如是否接收该频道的推送消息。推送通知仅适用于群组频道。
en: Update push preferences for a channel

Updates a user's notification preferences for a specific group channel identified by channel_url, such as whether to receive push messages for that channel. Push notifications are only available for group channels.

zh: 查看频道推送偏好
获取指定 user_id 用户在特定群组频道（channel_url）中的通知偏好，例如是否接收该频道的推送消息。推送通知仅适用于群组频道。
en: View push preferences for a channel

Retrieves a user's notification preferences for a specific group channel identified by channel_url, such as whether to receive push messages for that channel. Push notifications are only available for group channels.

zh: 添加注册或设备令牌
将指定 user_id 用户的注册或设备令牌添加到 Sendbird 服务器，用于代表服务器向推送服务发送通知请求。每种令牌类型各限 20 个；达到上限时添加新令牌前会先删除最旧的令牌，仅保留最新的 20 个。
en: Add a registration or device token

Adds a user's registration or device token to the Sendbird server so your server can send notification requests to push services on behalf of the user. A user can have up to 20 tokens of each type; the oldest token is deleted before a new one is added once the limit is reached, keeping only the 20 newest tokens.

zh: 查询设备令牌列表
获取指定 user_id 用户的注册或设备令牌列表。需在 token_type 中指定 gcm、huawei 或 apns，分别对应 FCM 注册令牌、HMS 设备令牌或 APNs 设备令牌。
en: List registration or device tokens
Retrieves a list of a user's registration or device tokens. Specify gcm, huawei, or apns in token_type for FCM registration tokens, HMS device tokens, or APNs device tokens, respectively.

zh: 移除指定设备令牌
移除指定 user_id 用户某个特定的注册或设备令牌。需在 token_type 中指定 gcm、huawei 或 apns 并传入对应的令牌值，分别对应 FCM 注册令牌、HMS 设备令牌或 APNs 设备令牌。
en: Remove a specific registration or device token

Removes a specific registration or device token from a user with the given user_id. Specify gcm, huawei, or apns in token_type and provide the token value, for an FCM registration token, HMS device token, or APNs device token, respectively.

zh: 选择推送内容模板
为指定 user_id 用户选择推送通知内容模板（default 或 alternative），决定推送消息在其设备上的展示形式。模板可在 Sendbird Dashboard 中自定义。
en: Choose a push notification content template

Chooses a push notification content template (default or alternative) for a user with the given user_id, determining how push messages appear on the user's device. Templates can be customized in the Sendbird Dashboard.

zh: 颁发用户会话令牌
为指定 user_id 用户颁发用于认证的会话令牌。会话令牌不存储于 Sendbird 数据库，提供无状态的认证方式并提升服务器性能；此接口取代了已弃用的令牌颁发方式，效率更高。
en: Create a user session token

Issues a session token for authenticating a user with the given user_id. Session tokens are not stored in the Sendbird database, providing an efficient stateless authentication method, and this endpoint supersedes the deprecated alternative.

zh: 查看含未读消息的频道数
获取指定 user_id 用户存在未读消息的群组频道总数。可通过多种查询参数确定群组频道的搜索范围。
en: View number of channels with unread messages
Retrieves the total number of group channels in which a user with the given user_id has unread messages. Use various query parameters to determine the search scope of group channels.

zh: 查看未读消息数量
获取指定 user_id 用户在群组频道中的未读消息总数。未读计数功能仅适用于群组频道。
en: View number of unread messages
Retrieves a user's total number of unread messages in group channels for the given user_id. The unread count feature is only available for group channels.

zh: 创建群组频道
创建用于一对一或一对多对话的群组频道，默认支持最多 100 名成员，超级群组（Supergroup）可扩展至数万名。频道可为私密（仅受邀加入）或公开，并支持输入指示、未读计数与已读回执；单个用户最多可加入 2,000 个群组频道。
en: Create a group channel

Creates a group channel for 1-to-1 or 1-to-N conversations, supporting up to 100 members by default and tens of thousands in Supergroup channels. Channels can be private (invite-only) or public, and support typing indicators, unread counts, and read receipts; a single user can join up to 2,000 group channels.

zh: 获取群组频道列表
检索应用内群组频道的列表，可通过多种查询参数限定搜索范围并选择要返回的频道信息。如需获取某个用户已加入的频道，应改用 User 模块下按用户列出群组频道的接口。
en: List group channels

Retrieves a list of group channels in the application; various query parameters let you narrow the search scope and choose which channel information to return. To list channels a specific user has joined, use the list-group-channels-by-user action under the User section instead.

zh: 删除群组频道
删除指定的群组频道或超级群组频道，需提供 channel_url。该操作会永久移除频道，属于不可逆的删除副作用。
en: Delete a group channel
Deletes the group channel or Supergroup channel identified by channel_url. This action permanently removes the channel and is irreversible.

zh: 获取群组频道详情
检索指定群组频道的信息，需提供 channel_url；可通过可选查询参数决定响应中是否包含投递回执、已读回执或成员信息。
en: Get a group channel

Retrieves information about the group channel identified by channel_url; optional query parameters determine whether delivery receipts, read receipts, or member information are included in the response.

zh: 更新群组频道
更新指定群组频道或超级群组频道的信息，需提供 channel_url。该接口不能修改频道成员，如需变更成员应改用邀请成员接口。
en: Update a group channel
Updates information about the group channel or Supergroup channel identified by channel_url. This API cannot change channel members; use the invite-as-members action to modify membership.

zh: 接受频道邀请
让用户接受群组频道邀请并加入频道。单个用户最多可加入 2,000 个群组频道，已达上限的用户的邀请会被自动取消。仅当应用的 auto_accept 属性设为 false 时该接口可用。
en: Accept a channel invitation

Lets a user accept an invitation and join a group channel. A single user can join up to 2,000 group channels, and invitations to users at capacity are automatically canceled. This action is only available when the application's auto_accept property is set to false.

zh: 隐藏群组频道
将群组频道从用户的频道列表中隐藏，用于归档频道。可仅为当前用户隐藏，也可为所有成员隐藏，并可决定新消息到达时频道是否仍保持隐藏。仅群组频道支持隐藏。
en: Hide a group channel

Hides a group channel from a user's channel list so users can archive channels and focus on important ones. You can hide it from the user only or from all members, and control whether it stays hidden when a new message is sent. Only group channels can be hidden.

zh: 取消隐藏群组频道
让已隐藏的群组频道重新出现在某个用户或全体成员的频道列表中，需提供 channel_url。仅群组频道支持隐藏与取消隐藏。
en: Unhide a group channel
Makes a hidden group channel reappear on the channel list of a specific user or of every member, identified by channel_url. Only group channels can be hidden or unhidden.

zh: 邀请成员
将一个或多个用户以成员身份邀请进群组频道，需提供 channel_url 与 user_ids。被邀请用户无需接受即可立即加入；如需让用户选择接受或拒绝邀请，可配置邀请偏好。
en: Invite users as members

Invites one or more users as members to the group channel identified by channel_url. Invited users join immediately without accepting the invitation; configure invitation preferences if users should be able to accept or decline.

zh: 加入公开群组频道
让用户加入公开群组频道，需提供 channel_url；仅 is_public 为 true 的频道可通过该接口加入。单个用户最多可加入 2,000 个群组频道，达到上限后无法再加入新频道。
en: Join a public group channel

Lets a user join a public group channel identified by channel_url; only channels with is_public set to true can be joined this way. A single user can join up to 2,000 group channels and cannot join a new one once at capacity.

zh: 离开群组频道
让一个或多个成员离开群组频道，需提供 channel_url 与 user_ids。离开后这些用户将从频道的成员列表中被移除。
en: Leave a group channel
Makes one or more members leave the group channel identified by channel_url; after leaving, the users are removed from the channel's member list.

zh: 获取频道成员列表
检索指定群组频道的成员列表，需提供 channel_url，可通过查询参数筛选与分页成员信息。
en: List group channel members
Retrieves the member list of the group channel identified by channel_url, with query parameters to filter and paginate the member information.

zh: 检查用户是否为成员
检查指定 user_id 的用户是否为 channel_url 对应群组频道的成员。
en: Check if a user is a member
Checks whether the user identified by user_id is a member of the group channel identified by channel_url.

zh: 取消操作者注册
取消 channel_url 群组频道中指定用户的操作者身份，但将其保留为普通成员，需提供 operator_ids。
en: Unregister group channel operators
Removes operator status from the specified users in the group channel identified by channel_url while keeping them in the channel as members. Provide operator_ids.

zh: 获取群组频道操作者列表
检索指定群组频道的操作者列表，需提供 channel_url。
en: List group channel operators
Retrieves the list of operators for the group channel identified by channel_url.

zh: 注册群组频道操作者
将一个或多个用户注册为群组频道的操作者，需提供 channel_url 与 operator_ids；操作者拥有频道管理权限。
en: Register group channel operators
Registers one or more users as operators of the group channel identified by channel_url; operators gain management privileges for the channel. Provide operator_ids.

zh: 重置用户聊天记录
重置指定用户在某群组频道中的聊天记录相关属性，仅清除该用户视角的既有消息，不删除数据库中的消息，其他成员仍可查看。通过更新频道的 last_message 与 read_receipt 属性实现。
en: Reset a user's chat history

Resets the chat-history-related properties for a specific user in a group channel, clearing existing messages only from that user's view. Messages are not deleted from the Sendbird database, so other members can still see them; this is done by updating the last_message and read_receipt properties.

zh: 开启输入指示器
为 channel_url 群组频道开启输入指示器，向其他成员显示指定用户正在输入的状态，营造更具实时互动感的对话环境。
en: Start typing indicators
Starts a typing indicator for the group channel identified by channel_url, showing other users that the user is typing to create a more interactive conversation environment.

zh: 关闭输入指示器
关闭 channel_url 群组频道的输入指示器，表示用户不再输入；用户发送消息或清空输入文本时，指示器也会自动消失。
en: Stop typing indicators

Stops the typing indicator for the group channel identified by channel_url to signal that the user is no longer typing; the indicator also disappears when the user sends a message or clears the message text.

zh: 创建开放频道
创建可容纳海量用户的开放频道，借助动态分区将参与者分散到各子频道。用户无需邀请即可加入，适合演唱会、直播等无需长期成员关系的短时活动场景。
en: Create an open channel

Creates an open channel that facilitates conversations for millions of users through dynamic partitioning into subchannels. Users need no invitation to join, making it suitable for short-lived live events like concerts or live streams that don't require sustained membership.

zh: 获取开放频道列表
检索应用内开放频道的列表，可通过各种查询参数限定搜索范围并选择要返回的频道信息。
en: List open channels
Retrieves a list of open channels in the application; various query parameters let you narrow the search scope and choose which channel information to receive.

zh: 删除开放频道
删除指定的开放频道，需提供 channel_url。删除后频道及其数据将不可恢复。
en: Delete an open channel
Deletes the open channel identified by channel_url, permanently removing the channel and its data.

zh: 获取开放频道详情
检索指定开放频道的信息，需提供 channel_url。
en: Get an open channel
Retrieves information about the open channel identified by channel_url.

zh: 更新开放频道
更新指定开放频道的信息，需提供 channel_url，例如添加封面图片以便识别频道，或设置自定义频道类型用于按类型分组管理。
en: Update an open channel
Updates information about the open channel identified by channel_url, such as adding a cover image to better identify the channel or specifying a custom channel type for grouping channels by type.

zh: 获取开放频道操作者列表
检索指定开放频道的操作者列表，需提供 channel_url。
en: List open channel operators
Retrieves the list of operators for the open channel identified by channel_url.

zh: 注册开放频道操作者
将一个或多个用户注册为开放频道的操作者，需提供 channel_url 与 operator_ids；操作者可管理该频道。
en: Register open channel operators
Registers one or more users as operators of the open channel identified by channel_url; operators can manage the channel. Provide operator_ids.

zh: 取消开放频道操作者
取消指定用户在开放频道中的操作者身份，但保留其参与者身份，需提供 channel_url 与 operator_ids。
en: Unregister open channel operators
Removes operator status from the specified users in the open channel identified by channel_url while keeping them in the channel as participants. Provide operator_ids.

zh: 创建公告
创建一条公告，用于向指定频道批量发送系统消息。也可在 Sendbird Dashboard 中创建并排期公告，需提供消息内容与目标频道。
en: Create an announcement
Creates an announcement that sends a message to target channels. Announcements can also be created and scheduled from the Sendbird Dashboard.

zh: 创建机器人
在应用中创建机器人，与创建普通用户类似，但需指定回调 URL 以接收事件。机器人需先加入群组频道才能与用户交互，也可通过邀请成员功能加入频道。
en: Create a bot
Creates a new bot in the application like a normal user, but requires a callback URL to receive events. The bot must join a group channel to interact with users.

zh: 列出所有机器人
分页检索应用内全部机器人的列表，返回机器人 ID、名称等信息，可用于管理应用中的机器人资源。
en: List all bots
Retrieves a paginated list of all bots in the application, including bot IDs and names, for managing bot resources.

zh: 机器人加入频道
让指定 bot_userid 的机器人加入一个或多个群组频道，之后机器人即可在这些频道中收发消息。
en: Make a bot join channels
Makes the bot identified by bot_userid join one or more group channels, allowing it to exchange messages there.

zh: 机器人退出全部频道
让指定 bot_userid 的机器人退出其加入的全部群组频道，之后不再接收这些频道的消息与事件。
en: Make a bot leave all channels
Makes the bot identified by bot_userid leave all group channels it has joined, so it stops receiving messages and events from them.

zh: 机器人退出指定频道
让指定 bot_userid 的机器人退出 channel_url 对应的单个群组频道，停止在该频道内的消息收发。
en: Make a bot leave a specific channel
Makes the bot identified by bot_userid leave the group channel specified by channel_url, stopping message exchange in that channel.

zh: 发送机器人消息
以指定 bot_userid 的机器人身份向群组频道发送消息，机器人需已加入目标频道。
en: Send a bot message
Sends a message to a group channel on behalf of the bot identified by bot_userid; the bot must have joined the target channel.

zh: 获取频道消息列表
按创建时间排序获取频道历史消息，channel_type 为 open_channels/group_channels，channel_url 指定频道；线程回复不与父消息分组。
en: List channel messages
Retrieves a channel's past messages in creation order. channel_type is open_channels or group_channels, channel_url identifies the channel, and thread replies are not grouped with their parents.

zh: 发送消息
向 channel_type 与 channel_url 指定的频道发送消息，支持文本、文件与管理员消息，也可附带上传文件，常用于业务方以程序化方式向用户发送消息。
en: Send a message
Sends a text, file, or admin message to the channel specified by channel_type and channel_url, with support for uploading files; commonly used for programmatic messages to users.

zh: 删除消息
从 channel_type 与 channel_url 指定的频道中删除 message_id 对应的消息，删除后该消息不再对频道成员可见。
en: Delete a message
Deletes the message identified by message_id from the channel specified by channel_type and channel_url, removing it from view for channel members.

zh: 获取单条消息
按 message_id 检索指定频道中的单条消息详情，channel_type 指定频道类型，channel_url 指定目标频道。
en: Get a message
Retrieves details of the message identified by message_id in the channel specified by channel_type and channel_url.

zh: 更新消息
更新指定频道中 message_id 对应消息的特定信息，如消息内容等字段，可用于编辑已发送的消息。
en: Update a message
Updates specific fields, such as content, of the message identified by message_id in the specified channel.

zh: 为消息添加附加数据
为指定消息添加一个或多个键值对形式的附加数据（排序元数组），用于存储消息的额外信息。
en: Add extra data to a message
Adds one or more key-value items to a message's sorted metaarray, storing additional information for the message.

zh: 移除消息附加数据
按键删除消息排序元数组中的特定附加数据项，仅移除指定的键值对。
en: Remove extra data from a message
Removes specific items from a message's sorted metaarray by their keys.

zh: 更新消息附加数据
按键更新消息排序元数组中指定附加数据项的值，可用于修改已存储的额外信息。
en: Update extra data in a message
Updates the values of specific items in a message's sorted metaarray by their keys.

zh: 获取频道消息总数
返回 channel_type 与 channel_url 指定频道中的消息总数（数量），可用于统计与展示。
en: Get total message count in a channel
Returns the total number of messages in the channel specified by channel_type and channel_url, useful for statistics and display.

zh: 标记全部消息已读
将群组频道中的全部消息标记为指定用户已读，用于已读回执。仅适用于群组频道中的用户。
en: Mark all messages as read
Marks all messages in a group channel as read for a specific user, supporting read receipts. Only applicable to users in a group channel.

zh: 批量迁移消息
将其他聊天系统的消息批量迁移到 Sendbird 目标频道（target_channel_url）。该功能需联系支持团队开通，迁移前需先通过用户创建 API 注册原系统用户。
en: Migrate messages in batch
Migrates messages from another chat system into the Sendbird channel identified by target_channel_url. The feature must be enabled by support; register existing users via the user creation API first.

zh: 创建频道元数据
为 channel_type 与 channel_url 指定的频道创建键值形式的元数据项，用于存储频道的附加信息。
en: Create channel metadata
Creates key-value metadata items for the channel specified by channel_type and channel_url, storing additional information about the channel.

zh: 删除频道元数据
删除指定频道中的一个或多个元数据项；不传键参数时删除该频道的全部元数据。
en: Delete channel metadata
Deletes one or all metadata items stored in the channel specified by channel_type and channel_url; without keys, all metadata is removed.

zh: 更新频道元数据
按键更新 channel_type 与 channel_url 指定频道中已有的元数据项，或向元数据中添加新的键值项。
en: Update channel metadata
Updates existing metadata items of the channel by their keys, or adds new items to the metadata.

zh: 获取频道元数据
检索 channel_type 与 channel_url 指定频道中存储的一个或多个元数据项，不传键参数时返回全部元数据。
en: View channel metadata
Retrieves one or more metadata items stored in the channel specified by channel_type and channel_url; without keys, all metadata is returned.

zh: 冻结群组频道
冻结或解冻 channel_url 指定的群组频道。冻结后频道成员无法发送消息，属于审核（moderation）工具。
en: Freeze a group channel
Freezes or unfreezes the group channel specified by channel_url. While frozen, channel members cannot send messages, serving as a moderation tool.

zh: 冻结开放频道
冻结或解冻 channel_url 指定的开放频道，冻结后频道成员无法发送消息，属于审核（moderation）工具。
en: Freeze an open channel
Freezes or unfreezes the open channel specified by channel_url, preventing members from sending messages while frozen.

zh: 封禁用户
让 user_id 用户屏蔽另一用户，使其不再接收被屏蔽用户的推送通知。在 1 对 1 群组频道中同时不再接收其消息；在 1 对 N 频道中仍可能收到消息，但不会收到通知。
en: Block a user
Blocks another user on behalf of the user identified by user_id, suppressing the blocked user's notifications; messages are hidden in 1-to-1 channels but may still arrive in 1-to-N channels.

zh: 查看封禁用户列表
检索指定 user_id 用户封禁的用户列表，或封禁该用户的用户列表（取决于查询参数），用于审核管理。
en: List blocked users
Retrieves the list of users blocked by the user identified by user_id, or the list of users blocking that user, depending on the query parameter.

zh: 解除用户封禁
解除 user_id 用户对 target_id 用户的封禁，恢复双方的消息与通知往来。
en: Unblock a user
Unblocks the user identified by target_id for the user identified by user_id, restoring message and notification exchange between them.

zh: 查看日活跃用户数
返回应用的日活跃用户数（DAU）数量。该指标每 30 分钟计算一次，自 UTC 00:00 起，首次更新在 00:30。
en: View daily active users
Returns the number of daily active users (DAU) of the application; recalculated every 30 minutes from 00:00 UTC, first updated at 00:30.

zh: 查看月活跃用户数
返回应用的月活跃用户数（MAU）数量。该指标每 30 分钟计算一次，自 UTC 00:00 起，首次更新在 00:30。
en: View monthly active users
Returns the number of monthly active users (MAU) of the application; recalculated every 30 minutes from 00:00 UTC, first updated at 00:30.
